notes: Hosted firmware catalog service. SU-08 compares the installed BIOS with the latest release for this model. The request sends only the vendor and 4-character model id (e.g. dell/0CF1): no serial number, device name or user details. Set baseUrl to "" to turn it off; SU-08 then uses the BIOS release date only. Plain http is only accepted for localhost. Records older than maxRecordAgeDays are not trusted; cacheHours controls how often the service is asked again.
